translations.literal: Dong'er would not comply, went to Congxin's tomb and wept, wished to hang herself on the tomb tree; her family guarded her and she did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Dong'er refused. She went to Congxin's tomb and wept, and tried to hang herself on the tomb tree. Her family guarded her and she did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 日暮還從信家，夜二鼓，入室更新衣，自經死。

translations.literal: At dusk she returned to Congxin's home; at the second watch of night she entered the room, put on fresh clothes, and hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk she returned to Congxin's home. At the second watch of night she entered the room, put on fresh clothes, and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 李氏，濱州惠高兒妻也。

translations.literal: Lady Li was the wife of Hui Gao'er of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Li was the wife of Hui Gao'er of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 年二十六，高兒歿，父欲奪歸嫁之，李氏不從，自縊而死。

translations.literal: At twenty-six Gao'er died; her father wished to take her back and remarry her; Li would not comply and hanged herself to death.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-six Gao'er died. Her father wished to take her back and remarry her. Li refused and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 脫脫尼，雍吉剌氏，有色，善女工。

translations.literal: Tuotuoni was of the Yongjiasi clan, beautiful in appearance and skilled at women's crafts.
translations.idiomatic: Tuotuoni was of the Yongjiasi clan, beautiful in appearance and skilled at women's crafts.

sentences.zh: 年二十六，夫哈剌不花卒。

translations.literal: At twenty-six her husband Halabuhua died.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-six her husband Halabuhua died.

sentences.zh: 前妻有二子皆壯，無婦，欲以本俗制收繼之，脫脫尼以死自誓。

translations.literal: The former wife had two sons, both grown, without wives; they wished by their native custom to take her in levirate marriage; Tuotuoni swore by death.
translations.idiomatic: His former wife had two grown sons without wives. They wished by their native custom to take her in levirate marriage. Tuotuoni swore she would die first.

sentences.zh: 二子復百計求遂，脫脫尼恚且罵曰：「汝禽獸行，欲妻母耶，若死何面目見汝父地下？」

translations.literal: The two sons again by a hundred schemes sought to succeed; Tuotuoni angrily cursed: "You beasts—do you wish to marry your mother? If you die how will you have face to see your father underground?"
translations.idiomatic: The two sons again schemed in every way to succeed. Tuotuoni cursed angrily, "You beasts—do you wish to marry your mother? If you die how will you face your father underground?"

sentences.zh: 二子慚懼謝罪，乃析業而居。

translations.literal: The two sons ashamed and fearful apologized and then divided the estate and lived apart.
translations.idiomatic: The two sons, ashamed and afraid, apologized and then divided the estate and lived apart.

sentences.zh: 二十年以貞操聞。

translations.literal: For twenty years she was known for chaste conduct.
translations.idiomatic: For twenty years she was known for chaste conduct.

sentences.zh: 王氏，成都李世安妻也。

translations.literal: Wang was the wife of Li Shi'an of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang was the wife of Li Shi'an of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 年十九，世安卒，夫弟世顯欲收繼之。

translations.literal: At nineteen Shi'an died; his younger brother Shixian wished to take her in levirate marriage.
translations.idiomatic: At nineteen Shi'an died. His younger brother Shixian wished to take her in levirate marriage.

sentences.zh: 王氏不從，引刃斷發，復自割其耳，創甚。

translations.literal: Wang would not comply, took a blade and cut her hair, then cut off her own ear; the wound was severe.
translations.idiomatic: Wang refused. She took a blade and cut her hair, then cut off her own ear. The wounds were severe.

sentences.zh: 親戚驚嘆，為醫療百日乃愈。

translations.literal: Relatives marveled and sighed; she was treated medically for a hundred days before recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives marveled and sighed. She was treated for a hundred days before she recovered.

sentences.zh: 狀上，並旌之。

translations.literal: The report was sent upward and all were commended.
translations.idiomatic: The report was sent upward and all were commended.

sentences.zh: 趙彬妻朱氏，名錦哥，洛陽人也。

translations.literal: Zhu, wife of Zhao Bin, named Jinge, was from Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu, wife of Zhao Bin, called Jinge, was from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 天歷初，西兵掠河南，朱氏遇兵五人，被執，逼與亂。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianli western troops plundered Henan; Zhu encountered five soldiers and was seized, forced to join their disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianli western troops plundered Henan. Zhu encountered five soldiers, was seized, and forced to join their disorder.

sentences.zh: 朱氏拒曰：「我良家婦，豈從汝賊耶！」

translations.literal: Zhu refused: "I am a decent family wife—how can I follow you bandits!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhu refused, "I am a decent family wife. How can I follow you bandits!"

sentences.zh: 兵怒，提曳棰楚之。

translations.literal: The soldiers were angry, dragged and beat her with cudgels.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers grew angry, dragged her, and beat her with cudgels.

sentences.zh: 朱氏度不能脫，即紿謂之曰：「汝幸釋我，舍後井傍有瘞金，當發以遺汝。」

translations.literal: Zhu judged she could not escape and deceived them: "You fortunately release me—behind the house by the well is buried gold; dig it up and I will give it to you."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu judged she could not escape and deceived them, "Release me. Behind the house by the well is buried gold. Dig it up and I will give it to you."

sentences.zh: 兵信之，乃隨其行。

translations.literal: The soldiers believed her and followed as she walked.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers believed her and followed as she walked.

sentences.zh: 朱氏得近井，即抱三歲女踴身赴井中死。

translations.literal: Zhu neared the well, embraced her three-year-old daughter and leaped into the well to her death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu reached the well, embraced her three-year-old daughter, and leaped into the well to her death.

sentences.zh: 是歲，又有偃師王氏女名安哥，從父避兵邙山丁家洞。

translations.literal: That year there was also the Wang family daughter of Yanshi named An'ge, who followed her father avoiding troops to Mount Mang at the Ding family cave.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was also the Wang family daughter of Yanshi named An'ge, who followed her father avoiding troops to Mount Mang at the Ding family cave.

sentences.zh: 兵入，搜得之，見安哥色美，驅使出，欲污之。

translations.literal: Soldiers entered, found them, saw An'ge's beauty was fine, drove her out and wished to defile her.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers entered and found them. Seeing An'ge's beauty they drove her out and wished to defile her.

sentences.zh: 安哥不從，投澗死。

translations.literal: An'ge would not comply and threw herself into a ravine to die.
translations.idiomatic: An'ge refused and threw herself into a ravine to die.

sentences.zh: 有司言狀，並表其廬。

translations.literal: The authorities reported the circumstances and all had their lodges commended.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities reported the circumstances and all had their lodges commended.

sentences.zh: 貴哥，蒙古氏，同知宣政院事羅五十三妻也。

translations.literal: Guige was of the Mongol clan and wife of Luo Wushisan, associate administrator of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guige was a Mongol woman and wife of Luo Wushisan, associate administrator of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.

sentences.zh: 天歷初，五十三得罪，貶海南，籍其家，詔以貴哥賜近侍卯罕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianli Wushisan was convicted and banished to Hainan; his household was registered for confiscation; an edict granted Guige to the close attendant Maohan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianli Wushisan was convicted and banished to Hainan. His household was registered for confiscation. An edict granted Guige to the close attendant Maohan.

sentences.zh: 卯罕親率車騎至其家迎之。

translations.literal: Maohan personally led chariots and horsemen to her home to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: Maohan personally led chariots and horsemen to her home to welcome her.

sentences.zh: 貴哥度不能免，令婢僕以飲食延卯罕於廳事，如厩自經死。

translations.literal: Guige judged she could not escape, ordered servants to entertain Maohan with food and drink in the side hall, then went to the stable and hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: Guige judged she could not escape. She ordered servants to entertain Maohan with food and drink in the side hall, then went to the stable and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 台叔齡妻劉氏，順寧人也。

translations.literal: Lady Liu was the wife of Tai Shuling and was from Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Liu was the wife of Tai Shuling and was from Shunning.

sentences.zh: 粗知書，克修婦道。

translations.literal: She roughly knew books and was able to cultivate wifely conduct.
translations.idiomatic: She had some knowledge of books and cultivated wifely conduct well.

sentences.zh: 一日地震屋壞，壓叔齡不能起，家复失火，叔齡母前救不得，欲就焚。

translations.literal: One day an earthquake destroyed the house and pinned Shuling so he could not rise; the house also caught fire; Shuling's mother rushed forward but could not save him and wished to throw herself into the flames.
translations.idiomatic: One day an earthquake destroyed the house and pinned Shuling so he could not rise. The house also caught fire. Shuling's mother rushed forward but could not save him and wished to throw herself into the flames.

sentences.zh: 叔齡望見，呼曰：「吾已不可得出，當亟救吾母。」

translations.literal: Shuling saw from afar and called: "I already cannot get out—you must quickly save my mother."
translations.idiomatic: Shuling saw from afar and called, "I cannot get out. You must quickly save my mother."

sentences.zh: 劉謂夫妹曰：「汝救汝母，汝兄必死，吾不用復生矣。」

translations.literal: Liu said to her husband's sister: "You save your mother—your brother must die; I have no need to live again."
translations.idiomatic: Liu said to her husband's sister, "You save your mother. Your brother must die. I have no need to live again."

sentences.zh: 即自投火中死。

translations.literal: She immediately threw herself into the fire and died.
translations.idiomatic: She immediately threw herself into the fire and died.

sentences.zh: 火滅，家人得二屍燼中，猶手相握不開。

translations.literal: When the fire was extinguished the family obtained two corpses from the ashes; their hands were still clasped and would not open.
translations.idiomatic: When the fire was extinguished the family found two corpses in the ashes. Their hands were still clasped and would not open.

sentences.zh: 官嘉其烈，上於朝，命錄付史臣。

translations.literal: Officials praised her fierceness, reported upward to court, and ordered it recorded and given to the historians.
translations.idiomatic: Officials praised her fierceness, reported to court, and ordered it recorded for the historians.

sentences.zh: 李智貞，建寧浦城人。

translations.literal: Li Zhizhen was from Pucheng in Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhizhen was from Pucheng in Jianning.

sentences.zh: 父子明，無子。

translations.literal: Her father Ziming had no son.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Ziming had no son.

sentences.zh: 智貞七歲能讀書。

translations.literal: At seven Zhizhen could read books.
translations.idiomatic: At seven Zhizhen could read books.

sentences.zh: 九歲母病，調護甚謹。

translations.literal: At nine her mother was ill and she nursed her with great care.
translations.idiomatic: At nine her mother fell ill and she nursed her with great care.

sentences.zh: 及卒，哀慟欲絕，不茹葷三年，治女工供祭祀，及奉父甘旨不乏，鄉里稱為孝女。

translations.literal: When she died Zhizhen grieved and wailed until near death, ate no meat for three years, did women's work to supply sacrifices, and in serving her father fine food was never lacking; the village called her a filial daughter.
translations.idiomatic: When her mother died Zhizhen grieved until she nearly died, ate no meat for three years, did women's work to supply sacrifices, and never failed to serve her father fine food. The village called her a filial daughter.

sentences.zh: 父嘗許為鄭全妻，未嫁，從父客邵武。

translations.literal: Her father once betrothed her to become Zheng Quan's wife; before marriage she followed her father as guest to Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Her father once betrothed her to Zheng Quan. Before the marriage she followed her father as a guest to Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 邵武豪陳良悅其慧，強納采求聘，智貞斷發拒之，且數自求死，良不能奪，卒歸全。

translations.literal: The Shaowu magnate Chen Liang admired her intelligence, forcibly sent betrothal gifts to seek her hand; Zhizhen cut her hair to refuse and several times sought death herself; Liang could not compel her and in the end she returned to Quan.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaowu magnate Chen Liang admired her intelligence and forcibly sent betrothal gifts. Zhizhen cut her hair to refuse and several times sought death. Liang could not compel her and in the end she returned to Quan.

sentences.zh: 事舅姑父母皆有道。

translations.literal: In serving parents-in-law and parents she had proper conduct.
translations.idiomatic: She served her parents-in-law and parents with proper conduct.

sentences.zh: 泰定間，全病歿，智貞悲泣不食，數日而死。

translations.literal: During the Taiding era Quan died of illness; Zhizhen grieved and wept without eating and died after several days.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiding era Quan died of illness. Zhizhen grieved, wept, refused food, and died after several days.

sentences.zh: 蔡三玉，龍溪陳端才妻也。

translations.literal: Cai Sanyu was the wife of Chen Duancai of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Sanyu was the wife of Chen Duancai of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 盜起漳州，掠龍溪，父廣瑞與端才各竄去，三玉獨偕夫妹出避鄰祠中。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou and plundered Longxi; father Guangrui and Duancai each fled; Sanyu alone took her husband's younger sister out to avoid trouble in a neighboring shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou and plundered Longxi. Her father Guangrui and Duancai each fled. Sanyu alone took her husband's younger sister to hide in a neighboring shrine.

sentences.zh: 盜入，斫夫妹，見三玉美，不忍傷，與里婦歐氏同驅納舟中。

translations.literal: The bandits entered, hacked her husband's younger sister, saw Sanyu was beautiful and could not bear to harm her; together with the village woman Lady Ou they drove them into a boat.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits broke in, hacked her husband's younger sister, saw that Sanyu was beautiful and could not bear to harm her, and together with a village woman named Ou drove them into a boat.

sentences.zh: 行至柳營江，迫妻之。

translations.literal: When they reached Liuying River they forced her to become wife.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Liuying River they tried to force her into marriage.

sentences.zh: 三玉佯許諾，因起更衣，自投江水而死。

translations.literal: Sanyu pretended to consent, then rose to change clothes and threw herself into the river water to die.
translations.idiomatic: Sanyu pretended to agree, rose as if to change clothes, and threw herself into the river to her death.

sentences.zh: 越三日，屍流至廣瑞舟側，廣瑞識為女，收斂之。

translations.literal: After three days the corpse drifted to the side of Guangrui's boat; Guangrui recognized it as his daughter and gathered it for burial.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later her body drifted to the side of Guangrui's boat. Guangrui recognized his daughter and gathered her remains for burial.

sentences.zh: 歐氏脫歸言狀，有司高其操，為請表之。

translations.literal: Lady Ou escaped and returned and reported the circumstances; the authorities prized her conduct and requested commendation for her.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ou escaped, returned, and reported what had happened. The authorities prized Sanyu's conduct and requested official commendation.

sentences.zh: 乃命旌門复役，仍給錢以葬。

translations.literal: They then ordered an honorific gate and restoration of corvée, and still gave money for burial.
translations.idiomatic: They then ordered an honorific gate erected, corvée restored, and money given for the burial.
